text_block_list.text:
At Tracen Academy, there is a horse girl duo who get along
like sisters... or rather, almost like mother and daughter.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
*yaaawn*...
Good morning, Cesario~

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Craft. Oh, did you just wake up?
You're such a sleepyhead as always.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Because the futon is so warm
and cozy~. Ehehehe...♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... Go get ready quickly.
Let's head to breakfast.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Mmmmmmmgh...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Craft?
You're glaring at that juice with such a sour look.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Kale juice is super bitter, you know...
Totally... On the very first sip,
I always go 'uuugh' inside...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Craft...
Yes, it certainly is bitter, but...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Everything served for breakfast has a purpose, I believe.
I'd like you to drink it, think you can manage?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh, I really don't wanna, but...
If Cesario says so!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: *gulp*, *gulp*, *gulp*!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: *pheeew*!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
My, good girl, good girl~!
That's my Craft♪
In the dorms, that's what the two of them are like, but——

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The first mock race of the morning...
It certainly tenses the spirit.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I shall let no one escape.
I will pass and outrun every single one of them!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I won't let that happen, Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that juice I'm wide awake,
and my vitamin levels are fully charged!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The one who's gonna win is me, Cesario!
I'll push so far ahead you'll never catch up!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, Craft...
Indeed, that is what makes you a worthy rival.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
None other than you stands before my path!
Here I come!

text_block_list.name: Craft & Cesario
text_block_list.text:
TAAAAAAAAH!
HAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Those two always have
such an interesting dynamic~

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, one minute she's like a guardian,
and the next they're clashing harder than anyone.
It's beyond special.
